metric_definitions.binary_ece: 15 equal-width bins of p_AI versus observed AI frequency
metric_definitions.multiclass_ece: 15 equal-width bins of top-label confidence versus top-label correctness
metric_definitions.macro_f1: full declared supported class set, zero_division=0; support is reported
metric_definitions.binary_balanced_accuracy: undefined unless both human and AI are present
metric_definitions.multiclass_balanced_accuracy: mean recall of classes present in evaluation subset
metric_definitions.auprc: average precision, positive class AI (or truly held-out AI for unknown benchmark)
metric_definitions.joint_vs_deployed: joint probability argmax may differ from the fixed-threshold deployment gate; both are reported separately
metric_definitions.binary_scope: ROC, probability metrics and fixed-AI-threshold binary counts include unsupported-language and short rows in their stated subgroup; they are not online AI/human/inconclusive decisions.
